review.tagline: Minimal PyTorch codebase to train and chat with a small GPT-2-class LLM
review.summary: nanochat covers tokenizer training, pretraining, SFT, RL, evaluation and a CLI chat interface in one small Python codebase. A single `--depth` setting derives width, heads, learning rate and training horizon, so one knob produces a compute-optimal model series. The reference speedrun trains a GPT-2-grade model in about 1.65 hours on an 8xH100 node per the leaderboard.
review.audience: Researchers and engineers learning or experimenting with end-to-end LLM training
strengths: Covers tokenizer, pretraining, SFT, RL, eval and inference in one repo
Single `--depth` dial sets all other hyperparameters automatically
Public time-to-GPT-2 leaderboard with commits and CORE scores
Same scripts run on one GPU via gradient accumulation, or on CPU/MPS
weaknesses: Reference speedrun needs an 8xH100 node, roughly $48 of rented compute
CPU/MPS path only trains a tiny model with weak results
Chat is CLI-only in the README; resulting model is small and hallucinates
needs: Models: nanochat GPT (depth-scaled), bfloat16, float32, float16
